# System packages Tileception needs on Debian, Ubuntu and Linux Mint.
#
# One package per line, with what needs it. `make deps` installs whatever is
# missing; `make check-deps` only reports. Whoever adds a feature that needs a
# system package adds it here in the same change.

[build]
pkg-config        # finds the libraries below at build time
libudev-dev       # monitors and input devices (Smithay udev backend)
libinput-dev      # keyboard, mouse and touchpad input
libgbm-dev        # GPU buffers for the screen
libseat-dev       # device access and switching consoles without root
libdrm-dev        # driving the display (DRM/KMS)
libxkbcommon-dev  # keyboard layouts
libpam0g-dev      # checking the password on the lock screen (tileception-auth)

[runtime]
xwayland                # X11 programs
dbus-bin                # dbus-update-activation-environment at session start
dbus-daemon             # the notification service's tests run a private bus
xdg-desktop-portal-wlr  # screen sharing and screenshots for apps (tileception-portals.conf)
xdg-desktop-portal-gtk  # file pickers and other portals (the portal config's default)
xdg-utils               # xdg-open and xdg-settings: default apps and screenshot actions
libgtk-3-bin            # gtk-launch starts the configured default browser desktop entry
xdg-user-dirs           # finds the Pictures folder for screenshots
grim                    # screenshots (tileception-screenshot)
slurp                   # selecting a region for Shift+Print
wl-clipboard            # copying screenshots to the clipboard
libnotify-bin           # notify-send, for screenshot and reload notifications
curl                    # cover art that media players serve over the web

[optional]
playerctl               # media keys (play, pause, next, previous)
wireplumber             # volume keys through wpctl
